Snapchat Note

Spend rose 87% (1,097 → 2,056 SAR) but bookings fell to 2 (from 6) — booking rate 11.1% (from 37.5%) and cost per booking 1,027.88 SAR (from 222.02). Small sample (18 leads reached), but the scale-up did not convert this period. Dr. Ahmed Gamal videos ran on Snapchat but produced only 1 booking. Next steps: run Dr. Kareem videos and test a new version of the 1,750 SAR per eye offer.

Instagram Note

3 bookings (from 2) and a 14.3% booking rate (from 12.5%) — the only platform where booking rate improved. Cost per booking edged up to 262.53 SAR (from 250.27) as cost per lead rose.

Facebook Note

Still the main driver — 12 bookings (71% of total) — but booking rate fell to 13.3% (from 21.3%) and cost per booking rose to 210.15 SAR (from 119.25).

Analysis

Performance Notes

Key observations & recommendations · 11 Oct – 19 Oct 2026 vs Oct 1-10 2026

Bookings fell to 17 (from 24) and cost per booking doubled to 315.60 SAR (from 155.86)
Leads grew 5.2% (210 → 221) but booking rate dropped to 13.2% (from 22.4%) and blended cost per lead rose 44.2% (16.69 → 24.06 SAR). Total spend was up 37.1% over a shorter window (9 days vs 10).
Doctor videos drove most of the bookings
14 of the 17 bookings came from doctor videos (Dr. Kareem 7, Dr. Ahmed Gamal 4, Dr. Tamer 3), and 3 came from offers: the 1,750 SAR per eye LASIK offer (2 — one on Facebook, one on Snapchat) and the 50% off eyelid offer (1).
Snapchat: spend nearly doubled, bookings fell from 6 to 2
Spend rose 87.4% (1,097 → 2,056 SAR) and delivery got cheaper (CPM 26.50 → 20.95 SAR, CPC 3.43 → 2.17 SAR), but cost per lead rose to 64.24 SAR (from 39.18) and cost per booking to 1,027.88 SAR (from 222.02). One of the reasons cost per lead went up is the new videos we launched this period (Dr. Ahmed Gamal videos), which produced only 1 booking. Only 18 leads were reached, so the sample is small — worth reviewing before adding more budget. Next steps: run Dr. Kareem videos and test a new version of the 1,750 SAR per eye offer.
Facebook: still 12 of the 17 bookings, at a higher cost
Cost per booking rose to 210.15 SAR (from 119.25) on a 13.3% booking rate (from 21.3%). Native cost per lead rose 38.4% (12.31 → 17.04 SAR) with leads flat at 148, as frequency climbed to 2.50× (from 1.90×) and reach fell 10.3%.
Instagram: the only platform where booking rate improved
Booking rate rose to 14.3% (from 12.5%) with 3 bookings (from 2) and leads up 20.6% (34 → 41). Reach fell 48.0% and CPM jumped from 14.97 to 38.74 SAR on a much smaller audience, while CTR more than doubled (0.96% → 1.99%). Next step: test running the Dr. Ahmed Gamal videos on Instagram again.
TikTok: more reach and views, fewer follows
Reach rose 17.7% and video views 44.9% at a lower CPM (4.70 SAR, from 6.40), but paid follows fell 29.0% (124 → 88). The Follow campaign delivered just 4,157 impressions for 162.86 SAR. Both campaigns show "Paused" in the export and Video Views carries a "Review issue & Appealed" status. No leads or bookings are tracked on TikTok.
Meta engagements fell 26.2% because the Engagement campaigns were nearly stopped
Engagement-campaign spend was about 11 SAR across Facebook and Instagram vs about 353 SAR last period, so post engagements dropped to 43,425 (from 58,867) even though the lead campaigns delivered more impressions. We have started running Engagement campaigns on Meta again to bring engagement back up.
Google Ads is not included in this report
No Google Ads data was provided for 11–19 Oct, so the totals above cover Instagram, Snapchat, Facebook and TikTok only. Next step: complete the Google Ads account verification so the account can run again.
